title: A coord ask cannot carry a session id: kbask redacts the UUID, so two sessions cannot tell each other how to be addressed
goal: a session can give another session the id to address it by through coord: kbask ask keeps a coord session id it can resolve to a live session/<id> presence lease, or coord offers a short addressable name per session, while redact still replaces every other UUID in ask text

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import redact;s='-'.join(['396fb440','d928','4c33','9f3a','b375f1a2bc1d']);o=redact.redact('address me as '+s);print(o);sys.exit(0 if s in o else 1)

notes: Found 2026-10-24 by the SP-3trnelzv orchestrator: an ask to any that named its coord session id reached the other session with the id as 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 (redact reads a UUID as an object id), and cross-session messages between the two were held by different permission modes, so coord asks were the only channel and carried no address.
